svg.title: Subtract the realized half before interpreting the remaining guidance
svg.desc: Subtract the realized half before interpreting the remaining guidance Vertiv | 2026 adjusted free cash flow | USD million | Guidance issued 2026-07-29 Full-year guidance midpoint: 2500.0 H1 actual: 1578.1 Implied H2: 921.9 Full-year range 2400-2600 -> implied H2 arithmetic remainder 821.9-1021.9 Full-year guidance - realized first half = implied remaining half Do not simply multiply Q2 cash of 925.3 by four; H1 includes working-capital changes and is not normalized FCFF. Sources: Vertiv Q2 earnings release and 2026 Q2 Form 10-Q. Author's like-for-like arithmetic, not a new earnings forecast.

g.text: Subtract the realized half before interpreting the remaining guidance
Vertiv | 2026 adjusted free cash flow | USD million | Guidance issued 2026-07-29
Full-year range 2400-2600 -> implied H2 arithmetic remainder 821.9-1021.9
Full-year guidance - realized first half = implied remaining half
Do not simply multiply Q2 cash of 925.3 by four; H1 includes working-capital changes and is not normalized FCFF.
Sources: Vertiv Q2 earnings release and 2026 Q2 Form 10-Q. Author's like-for-like arithmetic, not a new earnings forecast.
